*[[2024–2026 Cuba blackouts]], [[2026 Cuban crisis]]

*[[2026 Pacific typhoon season]]
**Two separate [[landslide]]s caused by [[Typhoon Bavi (2026)|Typhoon Bavi]] and the enhanced [[monsoon]] occur in the [[Philippines]]. Seven others are killed and two are injured in [[Calanogas, Lanao del Sur]], with [[search and rescue|search operations]] ongoing for four missing.
